name: Brazed Plate Heat Exchanger
shortDescription: Compact, gasket-free units ideal for high-pressure HVAC and refrigeration.
description: Brazed Plate Heat Exchangers (BPHE) consist of corrugated stainless steel plates vacuum-brazed together with copper or nickel. This eliminates the need for gaskets and thick frame plates, making them highly compact, lightweight, and capable of handling high pressures and temperatures.
